## What changed and why

## Checks

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` ...)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run test:e2e` and `npm run test:coverage` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has tests, and a bug fix has a test that fails without the fix (unit in `test/`, viewer flows in `e2e/`)
- [ ] Unit and e2e coverage each stay at 90% or more
- [ ] New interface text has a row in every language (see Localized text in CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or settings changed
